question: Soorya Classical Dance Festival is held in , __________ for 10 days every year.
solution:
​The correct answer is __**Thiruvananthapuram.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​**Thiruvananthapuram or Trivandrum** the capital of the southern Indian state of Kerala.
 
• **Thiruvananthapuram **is a major tourist Centre known for the **Padmanabhaswamy temple.**
 
• Thiruvananthapuram called '**'the evergreen city of India **''
 
• it's distinguished by its **British colonial Architecture **and many art galleries

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Rameswaram is a town on pamban island , in the **southeast Indian state of Tamil Nadu,**it is known for Ramanathaswamy temple.
 
• Madurai is an energetic, ancient city on the Vaigai river in the South Indian state of Tamil Nadu. Its skyline is dominated by the 14 colorful gopurams (gateway tower) of Meenakshi Amman temple.
 
• Mysuru a city of Indian Southwestern karnataka state , was the capital of the kingdom of Mysore from 1399 to 1947.
